title: APS score and threshold interpretation
content: The score estimates membership in recorded APS versus other component failures in the Scania benchmark. The threshold is a versioned review policy. Scores do not establish future failure, remaining life, physical cause, safe operation or mine-site performance. Anonymous predictors cannot justify repair advice. Read the exact probability and threshold from deterministic case evidence.
check: Read the pinned model card and compare the stored APS estimate with its exact threshold and quality status.
